entities.name: Nikollë Kaçorri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dom Nikoll Kaçorri, was a prominent figure of the National Renaissance of Albania. A signatory of the Albanian Declaration of Independence, Dom Kaçorri served as Deputy Prime Minister of the Provisional Government of Albania, after the independence.
